build_timm_backbone: build a detectron2 timm backbone from config with specified base name, output levels, and freeze settings
build_timm_fpn_backbone: build a detectron2 FPN backbone using a timm backbone as the bottom-up feature extractor
create_timm_resnet: create a custom ResNet model from timm with configurable output indices and pretrained weights
create_convnext_tiny_21k: create a ConvNeXt tiny model pretrained on ImageNet-21K with multi-level feature outputs
freeze_module: freeze all parameters of a PyTorch module and convert batch normalization to frozen batch norm
